hypotheses: Reading A (counts are in thousands): the schedule header prints '(in thousands)' with no exception for shares, while the balance sheet header prints 'except share and per share amounts'; the filer's own tags to 2025-06-30 put the printed count on the principal concept at decimals -3 (Holocene Topco preferred printed 136, tagged InvestmentOwnedBalancePrincipalAmount 136000). Under A, wrapper key units_tagged_as_par for the six accessions publishes 136,000, and the share tags from 2025-09-30 (unscaled) are 1,000 times too small.

Reading B (counts are as printed): from 2025-09-30 the filer tags the same counts with InvestmentOwnedBalanceShares unscaled (RxSense Holdings Group 14 at 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31 and 2026-03-31, printed 14). Under B, the early principal tags are the printed count x1000 by the schedule's scale and should be divided by 1,000; no wrapper key does that today.
Either reading applied alone breaks every equity chain by a factor of 1,000 at 2025-09-30. Needs the owner's ruling on the scale before anything is set; 36 to 65 equity rows a quarter.

Rollup 'Investments - non-controlled/non-affiliated Secured Debt Diversified Consumer Services' carries 41,330,000 (page subtotal '41,332 41,330 13.69'); its children sum 34,086,000; the 7,244,000 gap is not on a single member (fact_members.py finds no context with 7,244,000). Likely several rows on members spelled differently (e.g. 'Debt Diversified Consumer Services ...' without 'Secured'), as in the other three quarters; not located row by row in time.
